title: FI-JEPA executable synthetic baseline

task.target: Train-normalized synthetic future-block target used by the frozen downstream probe
task.horizon: Strictly later target block after a past-only context block
task.primary_question: Can latent prediction on deterministic synthetic regime-switching panels produce features useful to a frozen downstream probe?
task.failure_condition: No promotion beyond M1/E1 without the real-data, stronger-baseline, multi-seed and uncertainty gates documented in the project registry.

data.source: Deterministic synthetic regime-switching market panels generated by FI-JEPA
data.availability_time_notes: Context observations strictly precede target observations; no future sample may enter fitting or normalization.
data.universe_notes: Synthetic fixture only; no claim about historical asset-universe reconstruction.

splits.description: Chronological train/validation split with no shared observations.
splits.embargo: Implicit non-overlap from fixture construction; verify from implementation before any promotion.

baselines.name: persistence
baselines.notes: Current implemented comparator from the FI-JEPA synthetic baseline.

baselines.name: frozen-ridge-probe
baselines.notes: Frozen downstream probe used to evaluate learned representation utility.

metrics.name: probe_error
metrics.uncertainty_method: Not yet sufficient for promotion; multiple seeds and confidence intervals are required at the next gate.

metrics.name: above_training_mean_classification_accuracy
metrics.uncertainty_method: Synthetic auxiliary metric; explicitly not raw return-direction accuracy.

leakage_controls: All context observations precede all target observations
No future sample may enter fitting or normalization
Synthetic results must not be presented as realized returns or alpha

reproducibility.exact_command: python -m pip install -e 'FI-JEPA[dev]' && pytest -q FI-JEPA/tests && python -m fi_jepa.cli --epochs 40
reproducibility.artifact_path: No retained raw result artifact yet; CLI currently prints JSON.

claims.claim: FI-JEPA is an executable deterministic synthetic baseline.
claims.evidence: FI-JEPA implementation, tests, CLI and README.

claims.claim: FI-JEPA demonstrates real-market alpha or profitability.
claims.evidence: No licensed point-in-time real-market evaluation exists.

claims.claim: FI-JEPA is superior to strong financial baselines.
claims.evidence: Required stronger baselines, multiple seeds and confidence intervals are not yet complete.
